citation_replay.method: For each source_releases.json release, GET citation.url without resolving a branch; require the response revision to equal citation.observed_revision, then compare SHA-256 of the raw response bytes to citation.response_sha256.
citation_replay.purpose: Replays the metadata citation only. It must never execute repository code, download a corpus, or infer source rights from a successful response.

decision_replay.algorithm: Expand every inclusive record_id_range using record_id_format; require contiguous coverage from src:patent:0000 through src:patent:2173 and src:dutch-law:0000 through src:dutch-law:4998; require every expanded row to cite a permanently_quarantined release; require training_admitted_rows to remain zero.

input_inventory.source_revision_rule: Every source release must use the exact 40-hex revision recorded in the inventory; repository visibility, default branches, and card declarations do not admit rights.
